criteria.requirement: Add pyparsing.diagnostics.to_diagnostic(error) for real ParseBaseException only. Return fresh schema1 data with code parse-error/parse-fatal, clamped character offset/end_offset, one-based character line/column, EOF, exact original msg and optional parser node type. EOF span is zero-width; Unicode is character-counted, not bytes/display width. Keep expected=None rather than invent complete alternatives. Do not mutate exception, grammar or existing str/explain, and reject ordinary user action errors instead of misclassifying them as parser failures.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
